wiki.title: Diane Dixon (politician)
wiki.extract: Diane Brooks Dixon is an American politician serving in the California State Assembly. As a Republican, she represents the 72nd State Assembly District, which includes Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Seal Beach, Laguna Hills, Laguna Woods, Lake Forest, Aliso Viejo, Laguna Beach, and portions of Costa Mesa. She was a former mayor and city councilwoman of Newport Beach.
